name: aits
description: AITS — Adaptive Intelligence Thinking System. 12 cognitive agents (Meta-Orchestrator, Analytical, Critical-Validator, Creative-Generative, Emotional-Intuitive, Ethical-Governance, Optimizer, Predictive-Strategic, Foresight, Systemic, Memory, Dashboard) plus 4 slash commands (/aits-full, /aits-quick, /aits-diverge, /aits-board), 7 decision playbooks, conflict matrix, pattern library, and JSON schemas. Evolved from de Bono's Six Thinking Hats.
